name: DECA (high school division)
what_you_do: You can join a school club that prepares you for marketing, finance, hospitality and management careers. It has competitions and conferences.
who_can_apply: High school students join through a school chapter and its advisor, or a school can start a chapter. Contact the DECA advisor at your school.
pay_detail: Not stated on the pages read. Ask your advisor for chapter dues and conference fees.
how_to_apply: Ask your school for a DECA advisor. DECA lists an Online Membership System for joining.
notes: DECA says it has about 317,600 high school members in 4,510 chapters. Not every school has a chapter. California-specific details were not on the page.
